I took it for gospel that there was an issue with the hips and paid for the subscription to access the personalised flows. I did them religiously for the recommended 8 mins a day for a couple of months, but saw no improvement in my mobility test scores and was no closer to being able to sit on my heels, so I cancelled. Months later I saw a physio about something unrelated and she commented that I have extremely good hip mobility!! I explained this was something I was working on as I thought it was the root to my mobility issues. She said thereΓÇÖs nothing wrong with my hips, itΓÇÖs my quads that are extremely tight and restricting the movement. So the hours and ┬ú┬ú spent on hip mobility was all for nothing.
